description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class `EmployeeReportingMethodDaoTest` for testing the `EmployeeReportingMethodDao` data access object in the OrangeHRM project. It includes setup routines, various unit tests verifying methods that retrieve and manipulate employee reporting relationships, including supervisors and subordinates, and interactions with related data entities.

classes.name: EmployeeReportingMethodDaoTest
classes.description: A unit test class for verifying the behavior of EmployeeReportingMethodDao methods related to employee reporting relationships.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment; creates an instance of EmployeeReportingMethodDao and populates test data from fixture.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeReportToByEmpNumbers_WhenReportToAvailable
methods.description: Tests retrieval of reporting data when report-to information exists for given employee IDs.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeReportToByEmpNumbers_WhenReportToNotAvailable
methods.description: Tests behavior when no report-to data exists for specified employee IDs.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeSubordinatesCount_WhenSubordinatesAvailable
methods.description: Verifies subordinate count retrieval returns correct number when subordinates exist.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeSubordinatesCount_WhenSubordinatesNotAvailable
methods.description: Verifies subordinate count retrieval returns zero when no subordinates exist.

methods.name: testGetSearchImmediateEmployeeSupervisorsCount_WhenSupervisorsAvailable
methods.description: Verifies supervisor count retrieval when supervisors are present.

methods.name: testGetSearchImmediateEmployeeSupervisorsCount_WhenSupervisorsNotAvailable
methods.description: Verifies supervisor count retrieval when no supervisors are present.

methods.name: testSearchImmediateEmployeeSupervisors_WhenSupervisorsNotAvailable
methods.description: Verifies that searching for supervisors yields an empty array if none are available.

methods.name: testSearchImmediateEmployeeSupervisors_WhenSupervisorsAvailable
methods.description: Tests successful retrieval of supervisor data for an employee, including verification of properties.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeSubordinates_WhenSubordinatesAvailable
methods.description: Tests retrieval of subordinates for an employee, verifying subordinate details and reporting methods.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeSubordinates_WhenSubordinatesNotAvailable
methods.description: Verifies that retrieving subordinates for an employee with none returns an empty array.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeReportTo_WithSupervisor
methods.description: Tests saving a report-to relationship with a supervisor, verifying saved data.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeReportTo_WithSubordinate
methods.description: Tests saving a report-to relationship with a subordinate, verifying saved data.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeSupervisors
methods.description: Verifies deletion of specified supervisor relationships for an employee.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeSubordinates
methods.description: Verifies deletion of specified subordinate relationships for an employee.
